items.title: ServiceNow Stock’s (NOW) Historic Sell-Off May Have Gone Too Far
items.summary: ServiceNow (NOW) stock’s historic sell-off looks excessive to me. The enterprise workflow software provider disappointed investors with its Q3 earnings and outlook. I understand the frustration. Yet CFO Gina Mastantuono said, “Our AI momentum continues to build,” and the numbers support that view.
